assertions.name: quadratic Gauss sum over 5th roots of unity = √5

description: Grounds the H₂S Bring 1/√5 in the ζ₅ chiral fibre of Bring's surface. The chiral channel (c_λ=0 (2,1) = H₃ standard rep) IS the Bring chiral cubic fibre (3 sheets, B₃↠H₃ monodromy); Bring's surface carries the ℤ₅ automorphism (ζ₅=exp(2πi/5)) of 𝒳₅:y²=x⁵−1. √5 is the unique source of irrationality of ζ₅: cos(2π/5)=(√5−1)/4, disc(x⁵−1)=5⁵ (√=25√5), Gauss sum Σζ₅^(k²)=√5. So the archimedean ζ₅-residue normalisation is √5, and the leading chiral coefficient is 1/√5 — the Bring constant of the H₂S residual-mixing form. The exact ζ₅-residue normalisation remains the conjecture's open monodromy computation.

data.finding: The Bring 1/√5 of the H₂S residual is grounded in the ζ₅ chiral fibre of Bring's surface. The chiral channel (c_λ=0 (2,1) block = H₃ standard rep) is the Bring chiral cubic fibre (3 sheets with B₃↠H₃ monodromy); the surface's ℤ₅ automorphism (ζ₅=exp(2πi/5)) of 𝒳₅:y²=x⁵−1 supplies the 5-fold singular-fibre structure. √5 is the unique source of ζ₅'s irrationality over ℚ (cos(2π/5)=(√5−1)/4; disc(x⁵−1)=5⁵; Gauss sum=√5), so the archimedean ζ₅-residue is normalised by √5 and the leading chiral coefficient is 1/√5. Connection established (same H₃ object, ζ₅ ⇒ √5); the exact ζ₅-residue normalisation is the open monodromy step.
